concerns.text: FR-001 requires samples with no EDS data (Materials Project fallback failure) to be flagged 'incomplete', but T101's unified_dataset.csv column list and dataset.schema.yaml carry no incomplete/EDS-availability field. The fallback-flagging half of FR-001 is silently dropped.

FR-008 says the system 'must optionally exclude' depth-confounded samples when sensitivity analysis indicates high sensitivity; plan step 8 commits to 'Sensitivity Analysis & Conditional Exclusion'. T105 only reports Δr and 'whether excluding alters the conclusion' — no task produces the conditionally-excluded dataset or applies the exclusion threshold. The exclusion branch of FR-008 has no implementing step.

T104 must produce every element × metric combination including 'composite' (results.schema enum), and data-model defines composite_metric, but no task computes the composite metric — T102's spatial_metrics.csv has no composite column. The composite rows required by the contract cannot be produced from any task output.

Constitution VII requires statistical modeling to record confidence intervals for reported correlations. Neither T104's output fields nor results.schema.yaml include any CI field, and the schema's additionalProperties:false forbids adding one. A task deliverable falls short of a constitutional constraint.

Spec US-2 Scenario 3 and the data model distinguish is_undefined (autocorrelation never decays) from is_censored (correlation length exceeds image dimension). T102 collapses both into is_censored=true, and dataset.schema.yaml has no is_undefined field — the spec's 'undefined' flagging requirement is only partially implemented.

dataset.schema.yaml requires a single dataset with element, correlation_length, best_fit_model, low_freq_spectral_power, is_censored, censored_value AND pce/j_sc/v_oc/mask_percentage/co_location_status/depth_validation_status, with additionalProperties:false. No task produces a schema-conformant artifact: T101's unified_dataset.csv lacks the metric columns; T102's spatial_metrics.csv lacks the performance/validation columns. Either a task must emit the merged dataset or the contract must be revised — as written, T101/T102 deliverables cannot satisfy the contract they operate under.
T104 cites the schema as 'specs/.../contracts/results.schema.yaml' — a literal placeholder path. Resolve to the actual contract location before execution.
